claim_key_proposal.rule: Compare explicit scope contract, not arrival order or semantic similarity alone. Different times/versions/principals/purposes can denote different claims.

separations: authenticated source does not imply correct content
admissible input does not imply true world fact
receipt order is not object version or valid time

evidence_projection.negative: S- = exists eligible explicit opposing witness; not NOT(S+)

lineage.known_duplicate_root: Deduplicate per polarity; wrappers do not multiply canonical roots.
lineage.unknown_root: Keep partial/unknown; do not invent independence.
lineage.distinct_roots: May be correlated, independence remains undetermined.
lineage.same_root_opposite_reports: Can still be BOTH; diagnosis may implicate interpretations rather than independent measurements.

control_events.effect: Immutable observation identity, explicit positive or negative atom.
Retire selected observation without asserting negation; retain tombstone for late arrivals.
Validate replacement and scope before atomic retirement/addition; keep old observation.
control_events.limitation: Synthetic in-memory atomic update, no crash or transaction proof.

control_events.effect: A request to review, not automatically eligible opposing evidence.
Change use of one assessment, not source-observation existence.
Versioned authorized disposition with reasons; does not erase conflict or establish truth.

candidate_operation_policy.view: Any evidence state can reach separate access/authority check.
candidate_operation_policy.seek_evidence: Any state can reach separate tool/budget/authority check.
candidate_operation_policy.publish: Only SUPPORT_ONLY with synthetically complete coverage reaches candidate evidence gate; others UNKNOWN pending review.
required_in_real_adapter: Bind every policy input including coverage/criterion/adjudication/permissions as applicable.
Check operation and object version again before action.
Represent restricted evidence without silently declaring conflict absent.
Specify allowed exceptions/adjudication separately; retain contrary evidence.

future_obligations_not_run: Authority verification before a pre-arrival withdrawal tombstone is admitted
Time-window and criterion equivalence across observations
General compound support/opposition formulas or recursion
Product adapter refinement and task benefit evaluation
formal_model_revision_proposal: Do not alias S+ to unrestricted Supported when that predicate releases actions.
Add EvidenceState and versioned Assessment with input watermark, support/counter references, coverage and disposition.
Bind readiness to operation and current claim/policy versions; unresolved evidence remains UNKNOWN in the example publish policy.
Preserve P5 positive derivation formula; any opposing formula must be explicit, not absence of positive proof.
No blanket failure propagation; any proof depends on complete declared inputs and existing finite-DAG assumptions.
